policy.failure_charge: max(registered timeout + amortized training, observed wall + amortized training); not a measured TTT
policy.success_interval: Wilson interval for independent instances passing ALL registered seeds; run rate is descriptive
policy.other_intervals: 4000 instance-cluster bootstrap resamples; seeds stay together; seed=20261109
policy.population: Registered synthetic held-out corpus; not a claim about general industrial designs
policy.diversity: Distinct successful final structures within each identical input across seeds; pair distances conditional on success
policy.candidate_pool: Observed solver visits/quantum batches with unequal draw counts and early stopping; not state entropy or equal-budget diversity
policy.gap: Conditional on feasible returns; missing/infeasible quality is not silently imputed as zero
policy.baseline_selection: Instance-wise fastest observed baseline is descriptive and selection-optimistic; individual preregistered baselines also reported
policy.interval_limit: Bootstrap intervals with identical observations can be degenerate; they do not prove population certainty

hardware_note: Execution source labels are evidence claims, not independent physical-device verification
